title: Icon / Avatars
slide_intent: Adjust a recognizable face to its mask because the same crop does not work equally in square and circular frames.
strategic_value: Defined eye-mask spacing can keep Duo recognizable across Duolingo’s social avatars and small icons.
demonstration: Four avatar examples compare framing treatments; the text distinguishes square edge contact from circular side clearance and notes use as small as 16 px.
practical_value: Choose crop spacing based on the final avatar mask.

content_islands.name: Avatar comparison
content_islands.spec: Arrange the four framed examples in a row within the left panel.

content_islands.name: Mask-specific instructions
content_islands.spec: Place the heading, small-size example and square-versus-circle cropping guidance at right.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source says the icon keeps Duo’s personality central to social accounts.
reference_purposes.Application: The examples show how the face adapts to avatar masks.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The eye mask touches square-frame side edges but leaves side space as the mask approaches a circle.

ingredient.name: Duo avatar crop
ingredient.role: Keep facial recognition clear within different masks.
ingredient.application: Touch left and right edges in square masks; leave side space in circular masks.
ingredient.scope: Historical archived guidelines. Historical avatar guidance. The source describes use as small as 16 px; that is not the logotype minimum.
